description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultEntityId class, which is an immutable class representing an entity ID in the system. It includes methods for creating IDs, generating random IDs, and handling a dummy ID.

classes.name: DefaultEntityId
classes.description: A final immutable class implementing the EntityId interface, representing a unique identifier for entities, with special handling for dummy and randomly generated IDs.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates or returns a DefaultEntityId instance based on the provided CharSequence. If the argument is already a DefaultEntityId, it is returned as is.

methods.name: generateRandom
methods.description: Generates a new DefaultEntityId with a random UUID.

methods.name: dummy
methods.description: Returns a singleton dummy DefaultEntityId, which should not be used as a real ID.

methods.name: isDummy
methods.description: Checks if this ID is the dummy ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for this ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the ID.
